headline: Senate resolution would have asked the State Department for a report on El Salvador's human rights practices; the Senate declined to take it up.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 to formally request information from the executive branch about human rights practices in El Salvador. That part of the law lets Congress ask for a report on human rights in a country that receives U.S. security assistance. No official summary is available, so the specific details requested are not described here. On May 15, 2025, the Senate refused to take up the resolution or end debate on it.

who_it_affects.how: It would have been required to prepare and send the Senate a report on El Salvador's human rights practices.
Its human rights record would have been the subject of a formal U.S. government report requested by the Senate.
